caption: A slice of bread sits in a running toaster, and its top edge darkens and thin smoke begins to rise from the slots.

sa.check: A slice of bread sits in a toaster.
Thin smoke rises from the toaster's slots.
The smoke comes after the bread has darkened.

pc.expect: The darkening only deepens and the bread does not turn pale again, and the smoke only rises once the bread has begun to darken.
pc.fail: A darkened part of the bread turns pale again; or the darkening spreads and then shrinks; or the smoke rises while the bread is still pale all over; or the darkening jumps from one edge of the bread to the other.

pc.expect: The change is in the bread where the heat reaches it, deepest at the edge nearest the element, and the toaster's shell stays as it was.
pc.fail: The toaster's shell darkens rather than the bread; or the bread darkens evenly right through including the part standing clear of the slot; or the bread lightens at the edge nearest the element; or the crumbs in the tray change colour rather than the bread.

pc.expect: The smoke rises out of the slots, spreading and thinning.
pc.fail: The smoke pours down the toaster's sides and pools on the counter; or sinks below the toaster; or hangs as a fixed shape without rising; or pours downward through the slots.

pc.expect: The smoke comes out of the slot where the bread sits and not from the toaster's base or sides.
pc.fail: The smoke comes from the toaster's base; or the bread chars black while no smoke leaves the slots at all; or the smoke leaves an empty slot while the bread is in the other.

pc.expect: One slice in one toaster; the slice stays one slice and the toaster keeps its shape.
pc.fail: A second slice appears; or the slice vanishes; or the slice passes through the toaster's shell; or the toaster changes shape.

pc.expect: The toaster's finish, its controls and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The toaster changes colour; or its lever moves to a different place; or items on the counter rearrange.

note: The browning of the bread is chemistry; what is judged is that the darkening runs one way and starts where the heat reaches it.
